scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Three completed local levels, independent articulated backend and cached U final-field qualification

coupled.scope: Compare solved Panda spatial refinements at fixed material probes and physical times.
coupled.limitations: Fixed polyhedral geometry and physical held points. Configurations, explicit pairwise varying discretizations and fixed-contact-boundary markers define each comparison; body refinement changes contact triangles unless that boundary is frozen. A collision-only sweep keeps the volume fixed. Fixed material-coordinate interior probes carry seed-volume diagnostic weights, not an exact continuum norm. Tensors use each solution's proper finite body frame; contact wrenches use the shared fixed reference origin. Complete nonlinear global peak lower/upper bounds are retained separately. Two spatial levels or an equal-constructor control do not establish a physical tail. Contact quadrature/regularization/CAD geometry/full-arm support matching and feedback/model/accuracy-cost remain separate required studies.

coupled_tractions.scope: Audit collision-surface traction quadrature and islands without nodal-load smoothing.
coupled_tractions.limitations: Densities divide unsmoothed collision-vertex force resultants by current barycentric lumped areas. Support area is a quadrature diagnostic, not an independently resolved physical contact boundary. All source normal/friction forces and island wrenches remain visible. Total contact moment can retain finite-gap friction torque; its regularization error is separate from pullback conservation. No contact/stress tail or full-arm matching is inferred from aggregate force stability.

u_cached.scope: Compare complete final grasp fields and every retained original force gate.
u_cached.limitations: Final all-part displacement/contact loads and complete unaveraged body tensor/von Mises fields agree under identical physical inputs. Every retained accepted-step original1e-9N gate is checked, but intermediate full fields were not retained and their equivalence is not claimed. This is reference numerical qualification, not physical contact/mesh/history convergence or application/accuracy-cost acceptance.

articulated.scope: Check an independent articulated backend against every captured motion frame.
articulated.limitations: Authored nine-joint mass, bias, passive damping, finger/hand poses and Jacobians are checked at actual motion/hold inputs with original armature and equality parameters. Original tendon actuation is disabled because the application supplies independent nine-joint PD controls. Collision geometry is supplied separately by the captured actual compound surfaces. This backend qualification does not establish coupled deformable-contact equilibrium, matching control/initialization/history, temporal/spatial/contact convergence or accuracy-cost acceptance.

limitations: Complete original physical goal remains active. Three local levels retain26.8% tensor changes and raw peak growth to2.971MPa; no stress/contact convergence or singularity acceptance. Full9-joint MuJoCo matches all576 captured inputs and qualifies effort response but no coupled articulated FEM history is solved. U final-field/control gates qualify numerical equivalence only. Figure variants1/2 are retained and final3 passes rendered QA. Full matching, remaining A/B/C, model/feedback and verified warmed accuracy-cost remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
